name: Big number
summary: The receipt: one verified wall-sized number, label, and the source footnote.

slots.label: Eyebrow
slots.tooltip: A small label above the number, like "the receipt"

slots.label: The number
slots.tooltip: The one wall-sized number, written as you want it shown (e.g. 70× or $0.02). Keep it short.

slots.label: What it means
slots.tooltip: One line under the number saying what it measures

slots.label: Source note
slots.tooltip: Where the number comes from and how it was checked. Only show numbers you have verified.

slots.label: Backdrop
slots.tooltip: An image, video or moving pattern behind the number

props.label: Colour
props.tooltip: The colour of the big number and the backdrop

variant_axes.label: Spacing
variant_axes.tooltip: Roomy gives the number the whole wall; tight makes it smaller with less space between lines
